description: Seamless multi-account switching and account pool management for Antigravity IDE
config.title: Antigravity Kite
config.autoInstall: Silently install new versions when found
config.autoConfirmDeclaration: Auto-confirm the security notice (Security Notice & Data Use) when switching accounts, so no prompt appears. Requires the IDE to run with a debug port — the first switch will offer to enable it once (patches shortcuts and restarts the IDE). Without the debug port, the notice appears once per switch and must be clicked manually.
config.cdpPort: Debug port (--remote-debugging-port). 9222 is tried as an automatic fallback. Usually no need to change.
config.cdpHeartbeatMs: Heartbeat interval (ms) for auto-confirming the security notice. Lower closes dialogs faster at a small CPU cost. Takes effect immediately.
config.quotaRefreshMinutes: Interval (minutes) for the background refresh of all account quotas. Applies after the IDE restarts.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show the Kite status bar (account & quota items at the bottom right). Turning off hides all Kite status bar items.
config.statusBar.showAccount: Show the current account (email prefix) in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showModels: Show per-model quota percentages (Gemini / Claude, etc.) in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showCredits: Show the AI credits balance in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showPool: Show the account pool stats (available / total) in the status bar.
config.statusBar.position: Whether the Kite status bar items sit on the window's left or right side.
config.statusBar.style: Information density of the account/quota segment. The first four styles show only the lowest quota; labeled styles list every model. The fine-grained toggles (account/models/credits) apply to labeled & full styles.
config.statusBar.style.full: Account + tier + per-family quotas + reset countdowns + AI credits — full (default)
config.statusBar.showResetCountdown: Show a countdown to the nearest quota window reset (clock emoji) next to the quota figures.
config.statusBar.showTier: Show subscription tier (PRO/ULTRA) next to the account name. FREE stays unlabeled to keep the bar quiet.
config.statusBar.families: Which quota families show in the status bar (claude / gemini / argon=Gemini 4). Disabled pools are excluded from family segments and the tightest-quota aggregate.
config.syncGeminiFiles: Sync ~/.gemini oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json when switching accounts. Only turn this off if other tools such as AgyHop / Cockpit also manage these files.
config.locale: Language for the UI and messages. auto = follow the IDE language.
